metadata.coreContent: A Le Creuset Signature Enameled Cast Iron Round Wide Dutch Oven in a soft sea salt green color, shown with its lid on, resting on a white marble board next to a draped grey linen cloth.
metadata.style: Commercial Studio, Bright Minimalist, 4K Photorealistic, Lifestyle Cookware Photography
metadata.additionalDetails: The lid features the embossed 'LE CREUSET' brand name and a silver stainless steel knob with engraved branding. The scene is set on a light grey textured background.
